dict.string: PDF Page Editor Replace, remove, or insert pages in a PDF. Run it directly to pick a PDF in Files, or share a PDF to it. Scanning uses the free “Actions” app by Sindre Sorhus (Scan Documents). The original PDF is never overwritten.
